Raat ko din ki official story khatam ho jati hai. Meetings, errands, replies—sab thode dheere bolne lagte hain. Tab ek ajeeb sawaal bachta hai: aaj actually hua kya?

Iska jawab achievements ki list nahi hota. Kabhi tumne ek dost ki baat dhyan se suni. Kabhi galti se ek purana gaana suna aur das saal purani bus journey yaad aa gayi. Kabhi bas itna: aaj hawa thandi thi.

Sone se pehle ek line likho:

> Aaj ka woh pal jo kal tak nahi pahunchna chahiye, par shayad pahunch jayega:

Kuch dino baad pattern dikhega—kis cheez ko tum notice karte ho, aur kis tarah ka din tumhe sach me achha lagta hai. [[Yaad rakhne ka halka tareeqa]] isi ko sambhalne ka simple system hai.

Kal ki subah phir [[Chai ki aakhri chuski]] se shuru hogi.
